import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
ny_days = [f'01/01/{year}' for year in range(2021, 2026)]
df_ny = df[df['Date'].isin(ny_days)]
top_row = df_ny.loc[df_ny['Subways: Total Estimated Ridership'].idxmax()]
result = str(pd.to_datetime(top_row['Date']).year)
